[H3] Problem 1: The game save mechanism is not perfect, resulting in lost files in special cases! [/h3]
A: There are currently two mechanisms in the game: Automatic saving and Manual saving (to be optimized). There is a cloud saving mechanism on Steam (already available).
- Automatic saving: When the game is in progress, it will be automatically saved every 10 minutes. The saved files located in the root directory of the game with the suffix [.sav] are local saved files. Under special circumstances, such as power outages, the current save may not be automatically saved, and the Steam cloud save mechanism may overwrite it, resulting in inconsistent progress and "lost files".
- Manual archiving: In the game, select the menu in the upper right corner to return to the title interface, and the current progress will be archived to the local. The archiving file can be found in the [BeiFenData] folder in the root directory of the local game. Apply the save method -- select the.
